title: NaturalMobs
description: deletes monsters and makes mobs more natural
body:
### Did you ever hate them unrealistic Monsters?
This Mod makes unnatural monsters unable to spawn but still enable the spawn eggs and also makes the remaining mobs more natural. They now spawn in different sizes and of course the size also decides the amount of loot dropped and the health and strenght of the mob. friendly mobs now also spawn at night for a more alive night experience.
